$comment: Share images and social posts. The hero, window and cards layouts are the brand's image editor's (agd-playground src/components/agentcard-og/draw.ts, Editor.tsx, context-og/cards.ts), measured in units of the 1200 by 630 link preview's pixels and grown with the image's area (unit = sqrt(w*h / (1200*630))). Every color, radius, shadow, tracking and leading is read from brand/tokens.css; where the editor and the tokens disagree the tokens win and the disagreement is listed in notes.
source: agd-playground src/components/agentcard-og (draw.ts, Editor.tsx), src/components/context-og/cards.ts; routes /agentcard-og-image-playground (share) and /agentcard-social-post (social)

logoRule.note: The brand defines no minimum size or clear space. The CLI keeps a convention (the same one merch uses): clear space of half the lockup's height, and no smaller than 22 px high at the 1200 by 630 scale.

small.note: The floor for small words: 8 px at the width a size is usually shown at, never under 13 px at the 1200 by 630 scale.

notes: Display type: the editor sets headings, labels and keys in Neue Haas Grotesk Display or the installed Helvetica Neue. Neither ships (licence), so rendered images set them in Inter Medium, which is shipped in brand/fonts; tracking follows the tokens (--ds-tracking-display at 72px and up, --ds-tracking-tighter at 36px and up, --ds-tracking-tight below), not the editor's -0.05 and -0.035em.
Body leading: the editor uses 1.45, which is not a token; images use --ds-leading-snug (1.3).
Cards: the editor's card corner is 14px and its drop is 0 8px 24px ink at 18 percent; neither is a token, so cards use --ds-radius-card (12px) and --ds-shadow-card.
Footer address: the editor defaults to agentcard.com; images default to the host of brand.json site (agentcard.sh).

The editor's band divider reads a seeded value-noise tile for its grain; images use the library's grain (fractal noise at 0.95, two octaves, gray, soft-light), as registry/components/visuals/band-divider.tsx draws it.
Stickers are the editor's own art (public/agentcard-og/*.webp), converted to PNG in brand/illustration/objects because the renderer reads PNG and JPEG only.
Window bar labels are the user's to pass: the site's own labels (issuing.product) are not drawn by default.
Characters the shipped Inter cannot draw (emoji, Chinese, Arabic and so on) are refused, never drawn as empty boxes.
Safe areas, shown widths and upload limits are in the shared platform table (src/design/platforms.ts): each number is marked official (read on the platform's page) or approximate.
